headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when Andrade El Idolo vs. Jack Perry vs. Nick Wayne clashed for the AEW National Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.09 ? an excellent showing. In a wild three-way that saw all three men crash to the floor at once, Andrade El ?dolo hit Nick Wayne with the DM to retain the AEW National Championship over Wayne and Jack Perry.

On a Saturday in 2023, back when FTR vs. Cole & MJF clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 8.16 ? a fantastic contest. It was the first title opportunity of Cole & MJF's career. In an unlikely alliance that shocked fans, MJF and Adam Cole nearly upset FTR for the tag titles, with MJF sacrificing himself to save Cole from a Shatter Machine before Harwood stole the pin with a rollup.
Rewind to 2020, when Allin & Moxley vs. Cage & Starks settled things in a Tornado Tag match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 6.19 in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

secondaries.text: On a Friday in 2022, back when AEW welcomed Sonjay Dutt for the first time, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.58.

Flash back to 2026, when it was title-change night for the AEW World Trios Titles as The Demand vs. Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.37 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. The Demand dethroned the reunited Conglomeration (Cassidy, O'Reilly and Strong) for the AEW World Trios Championship.
Turning the clock back to 2026: it was Cage, Doyle & Fletcher's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.75 ? a match that delivered.
